}}'''Nildra''' is a [[maid]] who was in the employ of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nildra}}

==Appearance==
Nildra is a gray-haired woman who is described a stick-like{{ref/book|6|8}} and wiry.{{ref/book|8|18}}

==Activities==
Nildra was in charge of washing pots in Salidar. [[Marigan]] was one of the women working for her.{{ref/book|6|8}} When [[Egwene al'Vere]] comes to Salidar, she asks Nildra if she might show her where [[Sheriam Bayanar]] was. Nildra complains that when someone comes to the village, they always ask her for everything.{{ref/book|6|34}} After Egwene is raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in Salidar and opens the [[novice book]], Nildra asks about being tested.{{ref/book|8|18}}
